bayts.text: I seek refuge in God from my inclining towards what is not (His) good pleasure, and from my turning away from what has been laid down as Sunna or prescribed as duty.
It is incumbent upon me to be God's servant forever, together with the Book (the Qur'an): whoever rejects it is cut off (from grace).
My means is His servant, the Chosen One (Al-Mukhtār, Muḥammad), our master: he is the one for whom whoever refuses to place him first is brought low.
He is the Intercessor whose intercession I hope for in this world and the next, and I seek no recompense in exchange for him.
I pledged allegiance to him with my heart, when my eye had not yet seen him, and I serve him for (the love of) God as a duty.
I have surrendered my face forever to my Lord, through the Prophet (Muḥammad), together with the Book (the Qur'an) that has led to me what I aimed at.
To God belongs my whole being, as His servant forever; and I do not obey whoever has oppressed or rejected (the Truth).
To God I have repented, on this day, of my innovations (bidaʿ), and of every pact that, through doubt, was broken.
He is the Guardian (Al-Ḥafīẓ), who has been with me and protected my whole being: remove (O Lord) from me anguish and sickness.
You have erased (any chance) that Satan should head, ever, towards my horizons: so my pact is not broken.
We seek refuge in God, in secret and in the open, from the evil of Iblīs (Satan), wherever he shakes his head or rushes at a gallop.
Make for me, by Your safekeeping, a fortress that guards from harm, O Best of those who hold back (evil); and keep from me what scatters (al-faḍaḍ).
Today I have laid my state before You, hoping that You will subdue forever, for me, whoever has a sick heart.
My doubt and my (inner) whisperings have departed from my heart: so perfect me and set my dwelling in order for me.
Our adversary, Iblīs (Satan), full of wiles, heads for me; but You are my Lord and my Protector: so spare me exhaustion.
Make my purity good with security and safety from Iblīs (Satan), and suffice me against him forever, should he rise up.
Drive him away from me, O my Lord, together with what is with him, in this world and the next, frustrating him whenever he appears.
Cleanse my heart of all otherness (al-aghyār), making it full of scruple, O Best of those who have washed away with right guidance the affliction of my heart.
Turn away from me forever all the enemies, through the Prophet (Muḥammad), by subjugating them, O Best of those who bring low (the proud).
Yours are the treasuries: so open them for me and increase my glad tidings, and suffice me against whoever comes to obstruct.
I have hoped that You would turn every corruption away from me: fulfil my hope and unveil to me the secret of what is obscure.
My body, my family and my children are forever a trust with You: so spare us, in the two abodes, the ill of the Decree.
O You to whom the command belongs, be with me and protect me forever; and pour forth blessing unceasingly upon him whose love has been prescribed:
Muḥammad; then grant peace, together with his community, and through him make all that comes from me well-pleasing.
